title: A research protocol of an observational study on efficacy of microsoft kinect azure in evaluation of static posture in normal healthy population
protocol: Approach participants and screen for eligibility.
Orientation to the use of Kinect Azure for posture evaluation.
Administer and assess posture using Kinect Azure.
Perform statistical analysis on collected data.
Stand normally with the frontal plane of posture within sensor coverage.
Record and interpret data using normal posture landmarks.
Mount Kinect sensor to capture subject image.
Record age, weight, height, sex, and profession of individuals.
Use recorded information for better annotation of collected data.
